question: Which two Indian states have landfills identified among the world's top 25 "super-polluting" methane emitters in a 2025 report by UCLA's STOP Methane Project?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana and Maharashtra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Landfills located in **Telangana** and **Maharashtra** are listed among the top global methane emitters.
 
• The findings come from a satellite study identifying **25 landfill super-polluters** across **18 countries** worldwide in 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **UCLA's STOP Methane Project** published a report titled 'Spotlight on the Top 25 Methane Plumes in 2025: Landfills'.
 
• **Telangana and Maharashtra**: Two landfills located in these states have been identified as among the world’s top 25 **"super-polluting" methane emitters**.
 
• These sites are responsible for some of the highest methane emission rates detected from space in 2025.
 
• The top 25 facilities globally produced emission rates ranging from **3.6 to 7.5 tonnes of methane per hour**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Study Data**: The research analysed public data from the non-profit **Carbon Mapper**, which used satellite instruments to observe nearly **3,000 plumes** from over **700 waste sites**.
 
• **Global Emitters**: The highest-emitting site globally is a landfill near **Buenos Aires, Argentina** (7.6 tonnes per hour). Other nations with multiple top-emitting sites include **Brazil** and **Chile** (3 sites each), and **Saudi Arabia** and **Turkey** (2 sites each).
 
• **Environmental Impact**: A single source emitting 5 tonnes of methane per hour contributes as much to global warming as **one million SUVs**.
 
• **Health Risks**: Methane is a potent heat-trapping gas. Mitigating these emissions improves public health by reducing ground-level ozone formation. **India** currently experiences the highest total number of premature **ozone-related deaths** globally.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• According to a **2021 report** by the **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)**, the waste sector accounts for **20% of global anthropogenic methane emissions**.
 
• **India** holds the world’s largest potential for mitigation within the waste sector through cost-effective measures like organic waste separation.
 
• **Turkey**, the host of the upcoming **COP31 climate conference**, is highlighted as having three of the largest methane plumes.
